name: The Threatmill
author: Rava4U
description:
How long can you survive... THE THREATMILL?
Two playing modes:
AVOID'EM: just don't get hit!
CRASH'EM: get the good crates, avoid the bad ones!

V3.0:
-fixed a bug occurring during mode selection;
-code refactoring implementing event logic (just learned! :-) )

Once again, play and share your thoughts, opinions, critics and comments. And, if you like it... also share the game!
Enjoy!

Rava
